name: HD Textures
author: Neocron Community
description: Creative AI remaster of Neocron's world materials AND model textures (NPCs / mutants / power armor — subject-classified ORME) plus a hash-keyed PBR triplet index (2706 entries), consumed by the neocron-renodx-engine addon. World materials are regenerated by clarity-upscaler (guided by the 2004 original, tile/UV-aware so seams and mappings survive); model textures use a subject classifier (skin/cloth/mutant/powerarmor/robot) for correct ORME on UV atlases. Each texture is decomposed into AI surface normals and an ORME map (R=occlusion G=roughness B=metallic A=emissive). The engine binds the HD albedo (s0, bypassing the native 512px clamp), normals (s2) and ORME (s3) per texture and applies PBR-lite lighting on the game's baked lightmap. The full reproducible pipeline lives in pipeline/ (see pipeline/REPRODUCE.md). Non-world non-model gfx categories ship as the legacy Real-ESRGAN upscales for the native path; HUD/RPOS stays vanilla (client doesn't support scaled HUD).
